payload.name: Remote Desktop Commander
payload.description: 随时随地开发和自动化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reach an authorized computer's filesystem and terminal from ChatGPT through Desktop Commander's Remote MCP. The app relays a secure connection to a machine the user controls so ChatGPT can inspect files, run commands, manage processes, edit local documents, and automate development workflows from chat. Users stay in control of which devices are connected and can disconnect them at any time.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Desktop Commander 的 Remote MCP，从 ChatGPT 访问已获授权计算机的文件系统和终端。该应用将安全连接转接到用户控制的计算机，让 ChatGPT 检查文件、运行命令、管理进程、编辑本地文档，并通过聊天自动执行开发工作流程。用户始终可以决定连接哪些设备，并可随时断开连接。

payload.name: Outlook Email

payload.name: Supabase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage Supabase projects directly through ChatGPT. Execute SQL queries on PostgreSQL databases, design and modify table schemas, deploy serverless edge functions, and configure user authentication. Access real-time logs for debugging, create and apply database migrations, and manage development branches through natural language.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 管理 Supabase 项目。在 PostgreSQL 数据库上执行 SQL 查询，设计和修改表结构，部署无服务器边缘函数，并配置用户身份认证。获取实时日志以进行调试，创建并应用数据库迁移，以及通过自然语言管理开发分支。

payload.name: Flaim Fantasy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flaim connects ChatGPT to a user's ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper fantasy leagues so ChatGPT can answer questions about current leagues, standings, rosters, matchups, drafts and draft-pick ownership, available players, player search, recent league moves, league info, and past seasons using the user's actual league context. Ten of its eleven tools are read-only. The eleventh, refresh_leagues, is a bounded write that re-discovers leagues through the user's connected accounts and updates only Flaim's own connected-league registry. Flaim never makes trades, adds or drops players, edits lineups, or modifies league data on ESPN, Yahoo, or Sleeper. This application uses fantasy data provided by Yahoo Fantasy.
payload.longDescription: Flaim 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 ESPN、Yahoo 和 Sleeper 梦幻体育联盟，让 ChatGPT 能依据用户实际联盟情况回答当前联盟、排名、阵容、对阵、选秀与选秀权归属、可用球员、球员搜索、近期联盟变动、联盟信息和过去赛季等问题。十一个工具中有十个只读。第十一个 refresh_leagues 是范围受限的写入操作，通过用户已连接的账户重新发现联盟，仅更新 Flaim 自己的已连接联盟登记表。Flaim 从不交易、添加或移除球员、编辑阵容，也不修改 ESPN、Yahoo 或 Sleeper 的联盟数据。此应用使用 Yahoo Fantasy 提供的梦幻体育数据。

payload.name: WPVibe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WPVibe connects ChatGPT to self-hosted WordPress sites so users can manage content, inspect plugins and themes, upload media, run safe WordPress admin commands, use plugin abilities, and build draft themes through conversation. It includes tested WordPress skills and playbooks for Gutenberg, Elementor, SeedProd, classic themes, editable fields, design, and SEO audits, plus one-click authorization, permission-checked tools, and draft-preview-publish workflows so changes are visible and reviewable before risky actions.
payload.longDescription: WPVibe 将 ChatGPT 连接至自行托管的 WordPress 网站，让用户通过对话管理内容、检查插件和主题、上传媒体、执行安全的 WordPress 管理命令、使用插件能力，以及构建主题草稿。它包含经过测试的 WordPress 技能和操作指南，涵盖 Gutenberg、Elementor、SeedProd、经典主题、可编辑字段、设计及 SEO 审计；还提供一键授权、经过权限检查的工具，以及草稿—预览—发布工作流，让用户在执行有风险的操作前能够查看和审核变更。

payload.longDescription: Render 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看服务、部署、日志和指标；创建服务和数据存储；查询 Render Postgres 数据库；触发部署；以及管理环境变量。

payload.name: Shopify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Shopify for ChatGPT makes starting, running, and growing an online store as easy as having a conversation. Turn a small business idea into an ecommerce website with Shopify’s AI store builder: describe what you sell, create your store, add products, and sell online. Already have a Shopify store? Connect it to manage inventory across locations, create discount codes, review orders and customer details, and pull analytics on your store’s performance. Shopify supports selling online, in person, B2B, on marketplaces, and selling internationally. Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.
payload.longDescription: Shopify for ChatGPT 让开设、运营和发展网店像对话一样简单。使用 Shopify 的 AI 商店构建工具，将小生意的想法转化为电商网站：描述所售商品，创建商店，添加产品，然后在线销售。已有 Shopify 商店？连接后即可管理各地点的库存、创建折扣码、查看订单和客户详情，并获取商店经营表现的分析数据。Shopify 支持线上销售、线下销售、B2B、在交易平台销售以及国际销售。无论你经营按需印刷业务、销售数字产品、运营精品网店、采用一件代发，还是服务批发买家，Shopify 都能为你提供搭建业务、开展销售和实现增长的基础。

payload.name: HubSpot

Read from and write to deals, contacts, companies, tickets, engagements, and other objects you have permission to access. Prepare reports, update deal stages, log calls and emails, create tasks, or review pipeline details before meetings. Use it for quick updates in chat or comprehensive CRM management, all grounded in your actual HubSpot data. Learn more: https://knowledge.hubspot.com/integrations/connect-your-hubspot-account-to-chatgpt

payload.name: Windsor.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsor.ai connects your marketing and business data sources to your AI assistant, so you can ask questions and take action in plain English.

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions across every connected ad account
- Find and pause an underperforming Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads campaign
- Post or reply as your Instagram, Threads, Facebook, or Google Business Profile account
- Pull GA4, Google Search Console, or YouTube Analytics data straight into the conversation
- Sync HubSpot, Salesforce, or Shopify records
- Update a Klaviyo flow or an Amazon Seller Central listing

Connects to 350+ sources across advertising, analytics, organic social, CRM, e-commerce, email, and payments, including Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Company Pages, Microsoft Ads (Bing), GA4, Google Search Console, YouTube, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Google Merchant Center, Stripe, and GoHighLevel.

Reading data only requires connecting the relevant account once. Making a change (pausing a campaign, posting content, replying to a review) always asks for your confirmation first, and it is only available on platforms Windsor explicitly supports write access for. Every other connected source is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription:
Windsor.ai 将营销和业务数据源连接到你的 AI 助手，让你可以用日常英语提问并执行操作。

它可以从任何已连接的数据源获取表现数据，也可以在支持的广告和营销平台上直接进行修改，例如暂停或启用广告活动、设置预算、创建 Google Business Profile 帖子或回复评价；这些修改始终会在你确认后才执行。

常见工作流：
- 比较所有已连接广告账户的花费、点击和转化
- 找出并暂停表现不佳的 Meta Ads、Google Ads、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads 或 Microsoft Ads 广告活动
- 以你的 Instagram、Threads、Facebook 或 Google Business Profile 账户发布内容或回复
- 将 GA4、Google Search Console 或 YouTube Analytics 数据直接引入对话
- 同步 HubSpot、Salesforce 或 Shopify 记录
- 更新 Klaviyo 流程或 Amazon Seller Central 商品页面

连接广告、分析、自然流量社交媒体、CRM、电商、邮件和支付领域的 350+ 个数据源，包括 Google Ads、Meta (Facebook) Ads、Instagram、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads、LinkedIn Company Pages、Microsoft Ads (Bing)、GA4、Google Search Console、YouTube、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Shopify、Klaviyo、Amazon Ads、Google Merchant Center、Stripe 和 GoHighLevel。

读取数据只需连接一次相关账户。任何修改操作（暂停广告活动、发布内容、回复评价）都会先要求你确认，而且仅适用于 Windsor 明确支持写入权限的平台。其他所有已连接数据源均为只读。提供免费套餐，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台不存在关联，也未获这些平台背书。

payload.name: Parallel Search
payload.description: 面向 AI 的网页搜索

payload.longDescription: Parallel Search 提供可直接接入的网页搜索与内容提取能力。工具调用 Search API 和 Extract API 端点，确保智能体有效使用。在网上查找内容，避免浪费 token。

payload.name: Railway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Railway from ChatGPT with the Railway App and Railway Skills. Create and launch apps, understand how they’re performing, manage your projects, and troubleshoot issues.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Railway App 和 Railway Skills，在 ChatGPT 中使用 Railway。创建并上线应用，了解运行表现，管理项目，并排查问题。

payload.name: Interactive Brokers (IBKR)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Interactive Brokers account to ChatGPT and manage your portfolio through natural language. 
Ask about positions, balances, P&L, allocations, and open orders, or request real-time quotes and historical market data. 
You can also prompt ChatGPT to draft trade instructions — for example, "Buy 100 shares of AAPL at a limit of $200" — which are sent to your IBKR account for your review and approval. 
ChatGPT never submits orders directly to the market. Any trading symbols displayed or discussed are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to portray recommendations.
Member SIPC.
payload.longDescription:
将你的 Interactive Brokers 账户连接到 ChatGPT，通过自然语言管理投资组合。
询问持仓、余额、盈亏、资产配置和未成交订单，或请求实时报价及历史市场数据。
你还可以让 ChatGPT 起草交易指令，例如“以 $200 的限价买入 100 股 AAPL”，这些指令会发送至你的 IBKR 账户，供你审核和批准。
ChatGPT 绝不会直接向市场提交订单。文中展示或讨论的任何交易代码仅用于举例，不代表投资建议。
SIPC 成员。

payload.name: vidIQ
payload.description: 在 YouTube、IG 和 TikTok 上增长
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next video idea, learn from other creators, and improve your content with vidIQ in ChatGPT.

With vidIQ, you can:

• Find ideas and study competitors: discover videos outperforming their creators’ usual results on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. Find similar YouTube channels and explore their uploads.

• Check demand before filming: compare YouTube keyword search estimates and competition, explore related terms, and see views-per-hour trends where available.

• Understand your channel and audience: review YouTube views, watch time, retention and traffic sources. Explore comments for questions and ideas for your next video.

• Learn from other videos: break down hooks, structure and key moments with YouTube transcripts and visual analysis of videos, Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikToks.

• Improve your titles and thumbnails: get feedback on YouTube titles and thumbnails, generate alternative titles, and compare vidIQ scores before choosing what to test.

• Create and repurpose content: write scripts, generate creative assets, and turn long videos into vertical clips for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 vidIQ，寻找下一个视频创意、向其他创作者学习并改进内容。

借助 vidIQ，你可以：

• 寻找创意并研究竞争者：发现 YouTube、Instagram 和 TikTok 上表现超出创作者平常水平的视频。寻找相似的 YouTube 频道，并探索其上传内容。

• 拍摄前验证需求：比较 YouTube 关键词的预估搜索量和竞争程度，探索相关词，并在有数据时查看每小时观看量趋势。

• 了解频道和受众：查看 YouTube 观看次数、观看时长、留存率和流量来源。从评论中寻找问题和下一个视频的创意。

• 学习其他视频：利用 YouTube 文字稿，以及对视频、Shorts、Instagram Reels 和 TikTok 视频的视觉分析，拆解吸引观众的开场、结构和关键时刻。

• 改进标题和缩略图：获取 YouTube 标题和缩略图反馈，生成备选标题，并在选择测试方案前比较 vidIQ 评分。

• 创作和改编内容：撰写脚本、生成创意素材，将长视频转为适用于 YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels 和 TikTok 的竖屏短片。

payload.name: monday.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The monday.com AI Connector brings core platform capabilities directly to agents and AI assistants. It supports searching boards, creating and updating items and columns, assigning owners, setting timelines, and posting updates — enabling a wide range of work management and CRM use cases across teams and departments.

Teams of people and agents use monday.com as a task tracker and project tracking hub: planning campaigns and events, tracking milestones, dependencies, and workload, managing approval workflows and request intake, and sharing status updates across projects and portfolios — as well as a CRM for managing leads, contacts, and deals.

Beyond day-to-day work management, the connector lets agents answer questions using monday.com's official knowledge base, plan and build automations and multi-step workflows, run and save reusable code actions, and configure other monday.com agents .
payload.longDescription:
monday.com AI Connector 将核心平台功能直接提供给智能体和 AI 助手。它支持搜索看板、创建和更新事项及列、指派负责人、设置时间线和发布更新，让各团队和部门能够开展广泛的工作管理及 CRM 应用。

由人员和智能体组成的团队将 monday.com 用作任务跟踪器和项目跟踪中心：规划营销活动和事件，跟踪里程碑、依赖关系和工作量，管理审批流程及请求受理，并在各项目和项目组合之间共享状态更新——也将它作为管理潜在客户、联系人和商机的 CRM。

除日常工作管理外，该连接器还让智能体利用 monday.com 官方知识库回答问题，规划并构建自动化和多步骤工作流，运行和保存可复用的代码操作，以及配置其他 monday.com 智能体。

payload.name: Granola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Granola MCP connects your meeting history to ChatGPT so your assistant can pull real context from past conversations while you work.

Use MCP when you're already working on something bigger:

-   Writing PRDs or proposals: Pull customer feedback, stakeholder input, and decisions from relevant meetings directly into your draft
    
-   Building presentations or reports: Combine insights from multiple conversations with your other research and data
    
-   Coding with context: Give your AI the project background, requirements, and technical decisions discussed in planning meetings
    
-   Strategic analysis: Merge meeting insights with documents, data, and other sources for comprehensive analysis
    
How it works:

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."

The difference:

Instead of copy-pasting meeting notes into prompts, your AI pulls exactly what it needs from your meeting history automatically. You stay focused on the work, not the research or context.
payload.longDescription:
Granola MCP 将你的会议历史连接到 ChatGPT，让助手在你工作时从过往对话中提取真实上下文。

当你正在开展更大范围的工作时，可以使用 MCP：

-   编写 PRD 或提案：将相关会议中的客户反馈、利益相关方意见和决策直接引入草稿

-   制作演示文稿或报告：将多次对话中的洞察与其他研究和数据结合

-   带着上下文编程：向 AI 提供规划会议中讨论的项目背景、需求及技术决策

-   战略分析：将会议洞察与文档、数据及其他来源整合，进行全面分析

工作方式：

你的 AI 助手可以按主题、人员、公司或时间范围搜索 Granola 会议，并在回答中引用具体对话。不必再切换标签页查找“客户说了什么”或“我们何时作了那个决定”。

不同之处：

无需把会议笔记复制粘贴到提示中，AI 会自动从会议历史提取所需的具体内容。你可以专注于工作，而不是查资料或补充上下文。

New campaigns are always created paused for your review, and budget, bid, or status changes are made only when you explicitly ask — nothing goes live without your confirmation.
payload.longDescription: Adspirer 将您的 Google Ads、Meta Ads、LinkedIn Ads 和 TikTok Ads 账户连接到 ChatGPT，让您通过日常语言管理广告。查看已连接账户和广告活动表现，研究关键词与定向，审查转化跟踪，起草新广告活动和创意，并设置定期报告及阈值预警。新广告活动创建时始终为暂停状态，供您审查；只有在您明确提出要求时才会更改预算、出价或状态——未经您确认，任何内容都不会上线。

With the Klaviyo app, you'll stay informed on performance, ahead of opportunities, and ready to take action directly from a conversation.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中获取营销活动和自动化流程的表现、解释及建议，省去手动分析。报告包含发送状态、点击率和归因收入，并附有通俗说明。只需点击“Analyze”即可深入了解趋势和建议。借助 Klaviyo 应用，你能掌握表现、提前发现机会，并直接从对话中采取行动。

payload.name: Todoist: To Do List & Calendar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trusted by over 47 million people, Todoist simplifies tasks for individuals and teams. Instantly declutter your mind, boost productivity and use it as a habit tracker.

With a simple tap, add your tasks and remind yourself about them, enjoy multiple views like calendar, list and boards, filter tasks by work and/or personal life, collaborate on projects, and achieve peace of mind.

Why choose Todoist?
Todoist is a simple yet powerful planner tool that organizes both your life and work.

• Create a habit of adding tasks like “Plan next week’s work every Friday afternoon” or “Do homework every Wednesday at 6pm” using Todoist’s powerful language recognition and recurring dates.
• View any project as a list, as boards or as a calendar planner to give you ultimate flexibility when planning both your tasks and your time.
• Available on any device – with apps, extensions, and widgets – Todoist is everywhere you need it to be.
• Link Todoist with your calendar, voice assistant, and 100+ other tools such as Outlook, Gmail, and Slack.
• Collaborate on projects of all sizes by assigning tasks to others. Keep everything at hand by adding deadlines, notes, and files.
• Use one-tap templates to tackle everything from meeting agendas and accounting tasks, to packing lists and wedding planning.
• Instantly see what’s most important by setting visual task priority levels.
• Get to know your routine better with insights into your personalized productivity streaks.

Todoist on Apple iOS
• Todoist is beautifully designed, simple to get started, and intuitive to use.
• Stay organized from your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, while also syncing across desktop and all other devices.
• With natural language, write tasks like "tomorrow at 4pm" or “every other wednesday starting in two weeks” and Todoist will instantly parse it all out for you.
• Location-based reminders available on upgrade. Never forget an errand again.
• All the power from iOS: Siri, Today widget, share extension, handoff, and quick actions.

Questions? Feedback? Visit todoist.com/help

Recommended by: 
> The Verge: “Simple, straightforward, and super powerful”
> Wirecutter: “It’s simply a joy to use”
> PC Mag: “The best to-do list app on the market”
> TechRadar: “Nothing short of stellar”
payload.longDescription:
Todoist 获得超过 4,700 万（47 million）人的信赖，为个人和团队简化任务管理。立即理清思绪、提高效率，还可用来追踪习惯。

轻点一下即可添加任务并设置提醒，享用日历、列表、看板等多种视图，按工作和/或个人生活筛选任务，协作推进项目，让自己安心。

为什么选择 Todoist？
Todoist 是一款简单而强大的规划工具，让生活和工作井井有条。

• 借助 Todoist 强大的语言识别和重复日期功能，养成添加任务的习惯，例如“每周五下午规划下周工作”或“每周三下午 6 点做作业”。
• 将任意项目切换为列表、看板或日历规划视图，灵活安排任务与时间。
• 支持各种设备，提供应用、扩展和小组件；无论何时何地，Todoist 都能满足你的需要。
• 将 Todoist 连接到日历、语音助手及 Outlook、Gmail、Slack 等 100+ 款工具。
• 将任务分配给他人，协作开展各种规模的项目。添加截止日期、备注和文件，让一切随手可得。
• 一键使用模板，处理会议议程、会计任务、行李清单、婚礼筹备等各种事项。
• 设置直观的任务优先级，一眼看清最重要的事情。
• 通过个人效率连续记录的分析，更好地了解自己的日常习惯。

Apple iOS 上的 Todoist
• Todoist 设计精美，易于上手，使用直观。
• 在 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Watch 上保持有序，同时与桌面端和其他所有设备同步。
• 用自然语言输入任务，例如“明天下午 4 点”或“两周后开始每隔一个星期三”，Todoist 会立即解析。
• 升级后可使用基于位置的提醒，再也不会忘记外出办事。
• 充分利用 iOS 功能：Siri、Today 小组件、共享扩展、接力和快捷操作。

有问题或反馈？请访问 todoist.com/help

推荐媒体：
> The Verge：“简单、直接，而且非常强大”
> Wirecutter：“用起来令人愉悦”

> TechRadar：“表现堪称出色”

payload.name: SharePoint

payload.longDescription: Microsoft SharePoint 文档站点和 OneDrive 文件：查找内容、汇总文档、管理文件夹、共享资源。

payload.name: Superhuman Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Superhuman Mail to build powerful workflows across Gmail, Outlook, and Google Calendar. Search your inbox and calendar, summarize what matters, draft AI replies in your voice, check read statuses, prepare for your day, send emails or schedule events, and manage multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Superhuman Mail，在 Gmail、Outlook 和 Google Calendar 之间构建强大的工作流程。搜索收件箱和日历、总结重要内容、以你的口吻拟写 AI 回复、查看已读状态、为一天的安排做准备、发送邮件或安排活动，并管理多个 Gmail 和 Outlook 账户。

payload.name: Asana
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with your Asana tasks, subtasks, comments, due dates, and project details to create summaries, understand priorities, and prepare clear status updates
payload.longDescription: 利用 Asana 任务、子任务、评论、截止日期和项目详情，创建摘要、理解优先级，并准备清晰的状态更新

payload.name: Airtable
payload.description: 将结构化数据引入 ChatGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring operational data and context into the flow of your ChatGPT conversations. You can ask questions, create and update records, and analyze your data—all through conversation. Use the data in Airtable as input to the work you’re doing in ChatGPT, like building a landing page using content you’ve organized in Airtable. Make quick updates to Airtable without leaving the chat. Airtable for ChatGPT is ideal anytime you need quick access to structured internal data to inform your conversation.

Airtable's App connects ChatGPT directly to your Airtable bases, so you can ask questions, create and update records, and analyze your data—all through conversation
payload.longDescription:
将运营数据和背景信息融入 ChatGPT 对话。你可以通过对话提问、创建和更新记录，以及分析数据。将 Airtable 数据用于你在 ChatGPT 中开展的工作，例如利用在 Airtable 中整理的内容搭建落地页。无需离开聊天，即可快速更新 Airtable。当你需要快速访问结构化内部数据，为对话提供依据时，Airtable for ChatGPT 都是理想选择。

Airtable 应用将 ChatGPT 直接连接到你的 Airtable 数据库，让你通过对话提问、创建和更新记录，以及分析数据。

payload.name: Fireflies
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Fireflies app brings your meetings and knowledge directly into ChatGPT.

Analyze any conversation—sales, customer success, product, recruiting—for insights, action items, and sentiment. Track feature requests and pain points, update CRMs or systems of record, and instantly retrieve context from your organization's meetings.

With Fireflies and ChatGPT, centralize your company knowledge and turn every conversation into searchable, actionable insights.
payload.longDescription:
Fireflies 应用将你的会议和知识直接带入 ChatGPT。

分析销售、客户成功、产品、招聘等任何对话，获取见解、行动事项和情绪分析。跟踪功能需求和痛点，更新 CRM 或记录系统，并即时获取组织会议中的背景信息。

借助 Fireflies 和 ChatGPT，集中管理公司知识，将每次对话转化为可搜索、可采取行动的见解。

payload.name: Floot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and host full-stack apps using your own ChatGPT subscription. No AI build credits required. Floot MCP Server exposes the entire platform as native ChatGPT tool calls: create a project, write code, provision a database, enable auth, manage file storage, and deploy, all from a single conversation. Your ChatGPT subscription does the building. Floot handles the infrastructure. One conversation in, one working, hosted app out.
payload.longDescription: 使用你自己的 ChatGPT 订阅构建和托管全栈应用。无需 AI 构建额度。Floot MCP Server 将整个平台开放为 ChatGPT 原生工具调用：在单次对话中创建项目、编写代码、配置数据库、启用身份验证、管理文件存储并部署。你的 ChatGPT 订阅负责构建，Floot 负责基础设施。输入一次对话，产出一个可运行、已托管的应用。

payload.name: COROS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your COROS account to explore private activity records, laps and FIT files; understand sleep, heart rate, HRV, stress, wellness checks, menstrual cycle data, fitness and recovery; and view your profile and devices. Create and update running, cycling and trail-running training plans and workouts, save reusable workout templates, and arrange workouts on your training schedule. Changes are saved to your COROS account only when requested. Health insights are informational, not medical diagnosis or treatment.
payload.longDescription: 连接 COROS 账户，探索私密活动记录、分圈数据和 FIT 文件；了解睡眠、心率、HRV、压力、健康检查、月经周期数据、体能和恢复情况；查看个人资料和设备。创建和更新跑步、骑行及越野跑训练计划与训练项目，保存可复用的训练模板，并将训练安排到训练日程中。只有在你提出要求时，更改才会保存到 COROS 账户。健康见解仅供信息参考，不构成医学诊断或治疗。

payload.name: AppDeploy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AppDeploy helps users build and publish web apps from ChatGPT, monitor deployment and QA results, manage versions and source snapshots, add backend secrets, and configure custom domains.
payload.longDescription: AppDeploy 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 构建和发布网页应用，监控部署与 QA 结果，管理版本和源代码快照，添加后端密钥，并配置自定义域名。

payload.name: Fitness AI Connector
payload.description: 基于 Garmin 数据的 AI 教练
payload.summaryOriginal: AI coach for your Garmin data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Garmin wearable to get personalized health insights and AI coaching. Track daily wellness metrics including steps, heart rate, sleep quality, stress, and HRV. Analyze workouts with pace breakdown, lap splits, heart rate drift, and opt-in time-series data. Track weight, body composition, and menstrual cycle data. Monitor long-term fitness trends with up to 5 years of history. All data displays include Garmin attribution.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Garmin 可穿戴设备，获取个性化健康洞察和 AI 指导。跟踪步数、心率、睡眠质量、压力和 HRV 等每日健康指标。通过配速明细、分圈时间、心率漂移及经你选择同意提供的时间序列数据分析训练。跟踪体重、身体成分和月经周期数据。使用最长 5 年的历史记录监测长期体能趋势。所有数据展示均注明 Garmin 来源。

payload.name: Ahrefs
payload.description: 营销、SEO 和 AI 分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze keywords, rankings, traffic trends, backlinks, competitor performance, and brand visibility — including AI search and LLM mentions. Compare share of voice with competitors, find low-hanging keyword opportunities, review link-building strategies, and track performance over time. ChatGPT helps you work with Ahrefs data more effectively by combining multiple analyses, asking follow-up questions, and turning complex metrics into clear summaries and reports within a single conversation.
payload.longDescription: 分析关键词、排名、流量趋势、反向链接、竞争对手表现和品牌可见度——包括 AI 搜索和大语言模型提及情况。与竞争对手比较声量份额，寻找容易把握的关键词机会，评估链接建设策略，并跟踪长期表现。ChatGPT 在一次对话中整合多项分析、提出追问，并将复杂指标转化为清晰摘要和报告，帮助你更有效地使用 Ahrefs 数据。

payload.name: Opera Browser Connector
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Opera Browser to ChatGPT. When enabled, it can see open tabs, read page content, take screenshots of the page, and navigate to the page. And, based on the permissions you allow it, it could also view browsing history and close tabs

First ensure that Opera Browser Connector is enabled in Opera; 
Opera browser settings > search for "AI Services" > On Browser Connector click install

Once installed, the connector appears in Opera's toolbar, where you can manage connections to ChatGPT
payload.longDescription:
将 Opera Browser 连接到 ChatGPT。启用后，它可查看已打开的标签页、读取页面内容、截取页面截图并导航到页面。根据你授予的权限，它还可能查看浏览历史并关闭标签页。

首先确保在 Opera 中启用了 Opera Browser Connector：
Opera 浏览器设置 > 搜索“AI Services” > 在 Browser Connector 上点击安装

安装后，连接器会显示在 Opera 工具栏中，你可在那里管理与 ChatGPT 的连接。

payload.name: Webflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Webflow app connects your agents directly to your workspace. They can design, build, and manage sites and author, edit, and localize your CMS.  Built-in app skills let them ship custom code integrations, deploy web apps on  Webflow Cloud, and analyze site activity, performance, and AEO. 

New capabilities ship continuously directly to the app, giving your agents superpowers to run your entire digital presence remotely, through Webflow.
payload.longDescription:
Webflow 应用将您的智能体直接连接到工作空间。它们可以设计、构建和管理网站，并创作、编辑及本地化您的 CMS 内容。内置应用技能让它们能够交付自定义代码集成、在 Webflow Cloud 上部署网页应用，以及分析网站活动、表现和答案引擎优化（AEO）。

新功能会持续直接发布到应用中，让您的智能体获得强大能力，通过 Webflow 远程运营您的整个数字形象。

payload.name: Gmail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Gmail to summarize inbox activity, draft replies, and organize email threads through the connected Gmail app.
payload.longDescription: 通过已连接的 Gmail 应用，使用 Gmail 总结收件箱活动、拟写回复并整理邮件会话。

payload.name: Google Drive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
payload.longDescription: 使用 Google Docs、Sheets 和 Slides 开展工作。

payload.name: Google Calendar
payload.description: 管理 Google Calendar 日程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Google Calendar to summarize a day, check availability, list calendars, and create, update, or delete events directly from task prompts.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Google Calendar 概览一天的安排、检查空闲时间、列出日历，并根据任务提示直接创建、更新或删除日程。

payload.name: ClickUp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage tasks, collaborate with your team, and ship work without leaving ChatGPT or Codex. Post comments with threaded replies and @mentions to keep conversations moving. Send messages in ClickUp Chat. Write and edit Docs and pages. Track time, set custom fields, and search your entire workspace in natural language. Every action syncs to ClickUp in real time, so teammates see your updates instantly.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT 或 Codex，即可管理任务、与团队协作并交付工作。发表评论，使用串联回复和 @提及，让讨论持续推进。在 ClickUp Chat 中发送消息。编写和编辑 Docs 与页面。追踪时间、设置自定义字段，并用自然语言搜索整个工作区。每项操作都会实时同步到 ClickUp，团队成员能立即看到更新。

payload.name: Otter.ai
payload.description: 搜索 Otter.ai 中的会议
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Otter.ai MCP server connects ChatGPT to your meeting intelligence, enabling search and retrieval of transcripts, summaries, action items, and meeting metadata directly within your workflow. Search meetings by keyword, date range, attendee, folder, or channel, then fetch full transcripts with speaker attribution. Use it to prepare for meetings by reviewing past discussions, extract decisions from historical conversations, or synthesize insights across your meeting archive. Supports both personal and enterprise Otter.ai workspaces.
payload.longDescription: Otter.ai MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 连接到您的会议情报，让您直接在工作流程中搜索和获取文字记录、摘要、行动项及会议元数据。按关键词、日期范围、参会者、文件夹或频道搜索会议，然后获取注明发言人的完整文字记录。您可以回顾过去的讨论以准备会议，从历史对话中提取决策，或综合整个会议档案的洞察。支持个人和企业 Otter.ai 工作空间。

payload.name: GSC Wizard
payload.description: 分析 Google 搜索数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back. Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow. It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.
payload.longDescription: GSC Wizard 将 ChatGPT 连接到你自己的 Google Search Console 资源，让你用日常语言分析 SEO 表现。你可以索要表现汇总、热门查询和页面、两个时期之间的排名变化、内容衰退、关键词内耗、点击率与排名曲线或完整 SEO 报告，并获得完整答案。所有分析都在服务器端基于数据仓库计算，避免向模型传入数千行原始数据，让结果快速、准确且节省 token。你还可以列出并查看资源、运行 Google 的网址检查、追踪索引收录、管理主题集群和内容分组，并向 IndexNow 提交 URL。它还能就你已关联的 Google Analytics 4 资源提供报告，包括流量概览、维度拆分、电商、关键事件（转化）、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 等 AI 助手引荐的流量，以及合并 Search Console 与 GA4 数据的着陆页视图。汇总工具直接在 ChatGPT 中呈现交互式卡片和表格。所有访问均通过 Google 登录限定在你自己的账户范围内。

payload.name: Lovable
payload.description: 通过聊天构建全栈应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language. Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build. Follow-up messages refine the app, and you can inspect the generated code and diffs, add a PostgreSQL database and third-party connectors, manage reusable project knowledge and skills, and publish the finished app to a public URL.
payload.longDescription: Lovable 根据自然语言构建和编辑全栈 Web 应用。描述一个应用，Lovable 就会创建项目、编写 TypeScript、Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui 代码，并返回实时预览，让你看到构建过程。通过后续消息可以进一步完善应用；你还可以查看生成的代码和差异，添加 PostgreSQL 数据库及第三方连接器，管理可复用的项目知识和技能，并将完成的应用发布到公开 URL。

payload.name: Health
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中探索健康数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Explore your health data in ChatGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect supported medical records and Apple Health data to ground ChatGPT conversations in your health information, understand results in context, and follow changes in labs, sleep, and activity over time.
payload.longDescription: 连接受支持的医疗记录及 Apple Health 数据，让 ChatGPT 对话以你的健康信息为依据，结合背景理解结果，并长期跟踪化验、睡眠及活动的变化。

payload.name: Canva
Shopify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Shopify for ChatGPT makes starting, running, and growing an online store as easy as having a conversation. Turn a small business idea into an ecommerce website with Shopify’s AI store builder: describe what you sell, create your store, add products, and sell online. Already have a Shopify store? Connect it to manage inventory across locations, create discount codes, review orders and customer details, and pull analytics on your store’s performance. Shopify supports selling online, in person, B2B, on marketplaces, and selling internationally. Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.
payload.longDescription: Shopify for ChatGPT 让开设、运营和发展网店像对话一样简单。使用 Shopify 的 AI 商店构建工具，将小生意的想法转化为电商网站：描述所售商品，创建商店，添加产品，然后在线销售。已有 Shopify 商店？连接后即可管理各地点的库存、创建折扣码、查看订单和客户详情，并获取商店经营表现的分析数据。Shopify 支持线上销售、线下销售、B2B、在交易平台销售以及国际销售。无论你经营按需印刷业务、销售数字产品、运营精品网店、采用一件代发，还是服务批发买家，Shopify 都能为你提供搭建业务、开展销售和实现增长的基础。

payload.name: Adobe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Adobe 让你在对话中拥有更多创作和完成工作的方式。此前以 Photoshop 提供的 Adobe 连接器，如今涵盖 Creative Cloud 和 Acrobat 的创意与生产力功能。描述你想制作或修改的内容，Adobe 就能帮助将想法、图像、视频和文档变为精美成果——从编辑照片、创建 PDF，到设计社交媒体素材、调整视频尺寸、搜索 Creative Cloud 素材，以及生成数据驱动的文档。
主要功能：

* 精修人像或批量编辑照片：添加照片并描述你想要的效果——调整色彩、光照和色调；移除干扰元素并生成新元素；应用 Lightroom 预设；移除背景；模糊、裁剪、调整尺寸和扩展图像。
* 基于模板设计：从 Express 模板开始，更新文字和颜色，然后为社交媒体添加动画或转换为 PDF。
* 为任何平台优化视频：上传横向视频片段，要求重新排版以适配 YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels 或任何平台。你还可以将多个片段拼接为一个连续视频。
* 搜索和整理创意作品：描述所需内容，即可按主题、风格、氛围或内容从 Creative Cloud 素材库中找到素材，无需浏览文件夹。
* 处理 PDF 和文档：创建和转换精美的 PDF 和文档。
* 创建数据驱动的文档：描述想要的输出并提供数据——连接器将原始数据或内容转换为排版完善、可分享的 PDF，包括徽章、卡片、目录等。

你可以以访客身份开始使用，也可以登录 Adobe 账户，获得更多功能和工具、Creative Cloud 存储空间，以及跨会话保存的作品。

payload.name: tldraw
payload.description: 通过智能体进行绘制和流程图设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: tldraw puts an infinite canvas in Codex and ChatGPT.  Have your agent diagram your codebase or any process. Sketch a wireframe and have Codex turn it into an app. Pull in screenshots, annotate them, and ask your agent to update your project. Bring in your data and have ChatGPT visualise it on the canvas. And everything links to your files on tldraw.com.
payload.longDescription:
tldraw 将无限画布引入 Codex 和 ChatGPT 中。
让您的智能体为代码库或任何流程绘制流程图。
绘制线框图并让 Codex 将其转化为应用程序。
导入截图，添加注释，并让您的智能体更新项目。
引入您的数据，并让 ChatGPT 在画布上进行可视化展示。
所有内容均链接至 tldraw.com 上的文件。

payload.name: MagicPath
payload.description: 直接在 ChatGPT 中设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MagicPath is an Al design and prototyping tool for creating interactive websites, app interfaces, dashboards, and visual plans on a shared canvas. With the MagicPath plugin, describe what you want to make and turn your ideas, notes, or existing designs into editable work you can explore and refine.

Create a landing page, prototype an app, or design a dashboard with working interactions. Compare multiple Ul and UX design directions, refine layouts and content, and apply reusable themes for a consistent look. Turn meeting notes, product requirements, or a process into flowcharts, wireframes, user journeys, and workshop boards that make the next step easier to understand.

MagicPath supports designers, product managers, founders, marketers, developers, educators, and teams planning how something should look or work. Keep related designs together in team projects and share links for review. In a coding environment with file access, adapt existing React Ul code into MagicPath or export React and TypeScript components to continue implementation in your app.
payload.longDescription:
MagicPath 是一款 AI 设计与原型工具，在共享画布上创建交互式网站、应用界面、仪表板和视觉化计划。通过 MagicPath 插件，描述你想要制作的内容，把想法、笔记或现有设计变成可编辑的作品，供你探索和完善。

创建落地页、制作应用原型，或设计带有可用交互的仪表板。比较多种 UI 和 UX 设计方向，完善布局和内容，并应用可复用主题以保持一致的外观。将会议笔记、产品需求或流程转化为流程图、线框图、用户旅程和工作坊板，让下一步更容易理解。

MagicPath 支持设计师、产品经理、创始人、营销人员、开发者、教育工作者和规划产品外观或行为的团队。将相关设计放在团队项目中并共享链接供审阅。在拥有文件访问权限的编码环境中，可以将现有 React UI 代码调整到 MagicPath，或导出 React 和 TypeScript 组件，继续在应用中实现。

The Atlassian MCP Server connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Atlassian workspace, so you can work with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Loom, and more directly from your conversation.

payload.longDescription:
Atlassian MCP Server 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接至你的 Atlassian 工作区，让你直接在对话中使用 Jira、Confluence、Bitbucket、Loom 等工具。

Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.

payload.name: Docusign

payload.longDescription: 借助 Docusign 支持的智能自动化，简化合同管理。不仅完成合同签署，还能轻松处理复杂的协议工作流。使用自然语言创建和发送合同，立即提取续约日期、关键义务等重要信息，并自动执行工作流，让业务推进更快、更顺畅。

payload.name: Wix

Just ask Wix for the website you want, including all the functionality you need, and get a complete, business-ready site generated for you in minutes. You can also connect the perfect custom domain to your site and manage everything seamlessly in one place. For developers: build and deploy Wix apps with the Wix CLI, including dashboard extensions, backend APIs, site widgets, service plugins and data collections. Build headless sites with Wix Headless, fully hosted on Wix or self-hosted in any framework, powered by Wix backend services for eCommerce, bookings, CMS, events and members. Manage your store, bookings, contacts and site settings programmatically.
payload.longDescription:
直接在聊天中构建整个网站并购买域名。只需告诉 Wix 你想要的网站及所需的全部功能，几分钟内即可生成一个完整、可用于开展业务的网站。你还可以为网站连接合适的自定义域名，并在同一处顺畅管理所有内容。如有需要，可以继续在 Wix Harmony 编辑器中编辑，使用更多 AI 工具和流畅的拖放操作。

payload.name: HoneyBook

You approve what it can reach before anything runs, resource by resource, and nothing reaches a client until you send it. Each request runs in an isolated environment, and your credentials are never shared with the model.

Built for photographers, event planners, venues, designers and consultants. Requires a HoneyBook account.
payload.longDescription:
HoneyBook 为独立经营者和精简团队提供管理客户工作的场所：咨询、提案、合同、发票、付款，以及各环节之间的消息沟通。

连接账户后，在一次对话中处理完整业务。询问哪些潜在客户值得跟进，它会根据你自己的已预约业务给出排序结果。使用已保存的模板生成提案，并在发出前审阅。之后，可以询问谁还欠款，并向欠款客户发起付款请求。

任何操作运行前，你需要逐项批准它可访问的资源；只有你发送后，内容才会到达客户。每项请求都在隔离环境中运行，你的凭据绝不会共享给模型。

专为摄影师、活动策划人员、场地经营者、设计师和顾问打造。需要 HoneyBook 账户。

payload.name: Gusto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get people and payroll work done in ChatGPT with the Gusto plugin, don’t just ask questions about it. Prepare an upcoming payroll and review against recent runs to catch what needs attention before payday. Fix timesheets, bring in hours, tips, and reimbursements from spreadsheets, or onboard a new hire from their offer letter, all in a chat thread. The Gusto plugin for ChatGPT connects to your live people and payroll data, tools support detailed queries of structured data as well as writes that require confirmation.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Gusto 插件，直接在 ChatGPT 中处理人事和薪资事务，而不只是询问相关问题。准备即将进行的薪资发放，并与近期记录核对，及时发现发薪日前需要处理的问题。修正工时表、从电子表格导入工时、小费和报销款，或根据录用通知为新员工办理入职，全都可在聊天中完成。ChatGPT 版 Gusto 插件连接实时人事和薪资数据；其工具既支持对结构化数据进行详细查询，也支持需确认后才执行的写入操作。

Ten of its eleven tools are read-only. The eleventh, refresh_leagues, is a bounded write that re-discovers leagues through the user's connected accounts and updates only Flaim's own connected-league registry. Flaim never makes trades, adds or drops players, edits lineups, or modifies league data on ESPN, Yahoo, or Sleeper. This application uses fantasy data provided by Yahoo Fantasy.
payload.longDescription: Flaim 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 ESPN、Yahoo 和 Sleeper 梦幻体育联盟，让 ChatGPT 能依据用户实际联盟情况回答当前联盟、排名、阵容、对阵、选秀与选秀权归属、可用球员、球员搜索、近期联盟变动、联盟信息和过去赛季等问题。十一个工具中有十个只读。第十一个 refresh_leagues 是范围受限的写入操作，通过用户已连接的账户重新发现联盟，仅更新 Flaim 自己的已连接联盟登记表。Flaim 从不交易、添加或移除球员、编辑阵容，也不修改 ESPN、Yahoo 或 Sleeper 的联盟数据。此应用使用 Yahoo Fantasy 提供的梦幻体育数据。

It supports searching boards, creating and updating items and columns, assigning owners, setting timelines, and posting updates — enabling a wide range of work management and CRM use cases across teams and departments.

Teams of people and agents use monday.com as a task tracker and project tracking hub: planning campaigns and events, tracking milestones, dependencies, and workload, managing approval workflows and request intake, and sharing status updates across projects and portfolios — as well as a CRM for managing leads, contacts, and deals.

monday.com AI Connector 将核心平台功能直接提供给智能体和 AI 助手。它支持搜索看板、创建和更新事项及列、指派负责人、设置时间线和发布更新，让各团队和部门能够开展广泛的工作管理及 CRM 应用。

payload.name: Granola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Granola MCP connects your meeting history to ChatGPT so your assistant can pull real context from past conversations while you work.

Use MCP when you're already working on something bigger:

-   Writing PRDs or proposals: Pull customer feedback, stakeholder input, and decisions from relevant meetings directly into your draft
    
-   Building presentations or reports: Combine insights from multiple conversations with your other research and data
    
-   Coding with context: Give your AI the project background, requirements, and technical decisions discussed in planning meetings
    
-   Strategic analysis: Merge meeting insights with documents, data, and other sources for comprehensive analysis
    
How it works:

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."

The difference:

Instead of copy-pasting meeting notes into prompts, your AI pulls exactly what it needs from your meeting history automatically. You stay focused on the work, not the research or context.
payload.longDescription:
Granola MCP 将你的会议历史连接到 ChatGPT，让助手在你工作时从过往对话中提取真实上下文。

当你正在开展更大范围的工作时，可以使用 MCP：

-   编写 PRD 或提案：将相关会议中的客户反馈、利益相关方意见和决策直接引入草稿

-   制作演示文稿或报告：将多次对话中的洞察与其他研究和数据结合

-   带着上下文编程：向 AI 提供规划会议中讨论的项目背景、需求及技术决策

你的 AI 助手可以按主题、人员、公司或时间范围搜索 Granola 会议，并在回答中引用具体对话。不必再切换标签页查找“客户说了什么”或“我们何时作了那个决定”。

无需把会议笔记复制粘贴到提示中，AI 会自动从会议历史提取所需的具体内容。你可以专注于工作，而不是查资料或补充上下文。

payload.name: Todoist: To Do List & Calendar
